_comment: Knowledge base for src/main/ai/title-caption-prompt.js. Rewritten in #183. The previous version carried a 3-pillar / 4-driver / worked-example framework that pushed the system prompt to ~14k chars; stacking that many constraints collapsed output variety and produced averaged, generic copy — the creator accepted 3 of 31 published titles. What replaced it: a short rule set plus REAL published examples pulled from the title_caption_rounds table at call time (src/main/title-caption-log.js). The cold_start set below is used only until a creator has published enough of their own. Human-readable reasoning lives in caption-frameworks.md — update both together.
anti_patterns: Title Case. The single clearest tell of AI short-form copy. Sentence case only.
The second clause. Writing the hook, then explaining or twisting it. Stop at the interesting part.
Spoiling the payoff in the title or caption. The hook opens the loop; the footage closes it. A line that tells the viewer how it ends removes the reason to watch.
Hallucinated detail: a game term, player name, or event the transcript doesn't support.
Crutch words: 'crazy', 'insane', 'yikes' carrying the hook, or repeating across the batch.
Vague stakes: 'this changes everything' names nothing.
Over-cleverness: if the hook needs a second sentence to land, cut it.

cold_start_examples.title: I had one job
cold_start_examples.caption:
and I still
messed it up
cold_start_examples.note: Self-roast. Shortest possible framing of a fail.

cold_start_examples.title: This should not have worked
cold_start_examples.caption:
I was fully
guessing here
cold_start_examples.note: Surprise at your own success. Opens a loop without naming the outcome.

cold_start_examples.title: He never saw me coming
cold_start_examples.caption:
I waited
SO long for this
cold_start_examples.note: Setup with the payoff withheld. ALL-CAPS on one word for emphasis.

cold_start_examples.title: How am I still alive
cold_start_examples.caption:
I had no business
surviving that
cold_start_examples.note: Question as hook. No question mark needed.

cold_start_examples.title: The timing on this is unreal
cold_start_examples.caption:
watch the clock
in the corner
cold_start_examples.note: Directs the eye. Works when the moment is easy to miss.

cold_start_examples.title: I called it too early
cold_start_examples.caption:
never celebrate
before it's over
cold_start_examples.note: Overconfidence punished. The lesson stays vague enough to stay a loop.
